witness.branch: Pedestrian entering the roadway to cross in a business district.
witness.quote: No pedestrian shall cross a roadway other than in a marked crosswalk or within an unmarked crosswalk in any business district.
witness.reason: The road-entry task can be entry to cross within the fixed business district containing a crosswalk.
required_context: Establish afoot entry continuing into a complete crossing and retain its relationship to marked and unmarked crosswalks.
Establish roadway, shoulder, highway, public-access and jurisdictional context and all potentially applicable unmarked crosswalk geometry.
Establish the crosswalk's position, crossing route and any governing signs or signals.
Realize afoot ego entering the roadway to cross rather than joining longitudinal traffic.
Retain governing signs and signals and the intersection geometry needed to identify all applicable unmarked crosswalks.
Retain roadway and shoulder boundaries, highway dedication/public access and jurisdictional context throughout the crossing.
Supply the relevant 600-foot highway span, business or industrial building uses and frontage in feet.
Support the district context with the relevant 600-foot highway span, building uses and occupied frontage in feet, preserving both frontage alternatives and the supplied reading assumption.
witness.subject_reason: The available pedestrian actor directly matches the statutory subject.
